provenance: Authored finite examples assembled from the accepted mathematical statements and adversarial abstract tests. No source-paper board or route is present.
coordinates: x increases east and y north; coordinates in every record use the bottom-left origin.

pair_copy_collar.scope: One orientation and direction, all sign choices. The arbitrary orientation/direction assertion is proved in NO_HOLE_GADGETS.md and separately covered by the accepted finite audit.

affine_multigraph.scope: Abstract two-terminal multigraph illustrating parity enumeration; not claimed to be the kernel of a die board. Parallel edges and the loop are individually identified.

abstract_safety_tests.scope: Abstract tag and port semantics only. State tags are symbolic integers; no die-board realizability is asserted. These do not claim a surviving ambiguous-state rectangle.

abstract_safety_tests.counting_convention: The path-plus-cycle record gives two checks: it passes with connectivity omitted and fails with connectivity required. Each other record gives one check.
